text_block_list.text:
Бива Хаяхидэ and I go to see the
Satsuki Sho
together, and she keeps her
eyes silently glued to
Нарита Брайан the
whole time.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Though Нарита Брайан wins the race with a
record
breaking time, Бива Хаяхидэ
boldly declares
that she will beat her
sister.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, I get word that the venue for
the
spring Tenno Sho is being changed
to the Hanshin
Racecourse.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Despite this, Бива Хаяхидэ is unfazed
by the
prospect of having to rebuild our
strategy. That's
when I realize how much
she's grown.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
